issues.description: The problem statement specifies build_msd_circ(circ: stim.Circuit, distilled_state: int, y_states: tuple[int]) but both the template and solution define the parameter as y_states: list[int]. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected container type (immutability/tuple vs mutable/list) and may cause type-checking or test-harness mismatches if tests follow the statement literally.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent. Easiest: update the problem statement signature to use y_states: list[int] (or Sequence[int]). Alternatively, change template+solution annotations to tuple[int, ...] if immutability is intended.
